source_evidence: Player exact 'Would you rather contend with a neighbor that tell you your crown is disputed for the last century and done nothing about it... or one that is knocking at your door, taking your land, and experimenting on your people?' V gives opinion in response to councillor's question. NPCs distinguish historical war (~80 years since separation) and current rivalry from active expansion. They acknowledge strategic point without treating V's rhetorical statement as proof of experiments on Crownsunder citizens. Elara and Assembly representative support limited cooperation while preserving independent claims. General offers qualified consideration, not unconditional political agreement. Councillor raises limited exploratory reciprocal sharing of corroborated raid warnings and relevant evidence, withholding sensitive defenses and preserving sovereignty; proposes possible confidential preliminary invitation carried by V on intended Orsaven visit, or ordinary diplomatic channel. No new roll: exchange of views and conditional proposal rather than binding concession or contested final decision. No assignment accepted, no letter issued, no policy enacted, no payment or expenditure. D316~14:10 Caereth palace defense consultation, V and Elara invited speakers, councillor, royal advisers, Assembly delegates and senior general present. V challenges prioritization of a longstanding disputed Crown over Veyr's active expansion and experimentation, exact player speech preserved. General notes actual succession war began roughly80 years ago, not century of literal inaction, but concedes distinction between current dynastic stalemate and expanding Veyran threat. Assembly representative and Elara independently support cooperation without renouncing either side's dynastic claims. Councillor suggests exploratory limited mutual intelligence arrangement: verified frontier raid warnings and evidence of coercive operations, reciprocal channels, no disclosure of fortress dispositions or surrender of sovereignty, no alliance or troop commitment yet. General willing to consider scoped exchanges but wants reciprocity and security safeguards. Councillor asks whether V would be willing, when next traveling to Orsaven, to convey a confidential preliminary invitation to appropriate Ossent authorities, or prefers Crown use existing diplomatic channels. No letter drafted/issued, no acceptance of assignment, no military or legislative decision, no new evidence establishing experimentation on Crownsunder subjects. Kestrel evidence supports abuse at Veyran facility and regional bureau link, not proven wider atrocities against foreign citizens. All character resources and custody unchanged: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots; companions/coach/horses safe at Elara residence. Rest0/6 food21/feed28 purse2903gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp loot sale unpaid; three early silver items unverified. Crown frontier commission active remaining300+1300 contingent, credentials V-held. Defense of Caereth complete, Elara standing representative, three-House recognition pending Severin assent, no reply. V dice delegated until stop. Await V response.
